stories.title: Verstappen wins Singapore Grand Prix for the first time
stories.summary: Max Verstappen led the 62-lap race from pole to take his 73rd career win and first ever in Singapore on his 250th Grand Prix start, 7.3s clear of Charles Leclerc. The result completes a perfect weekend (sprint + pole + race) and confirms Red Bull's return to the front after back-to-back wins.

stories.title: Hamilton apologises to Ferrari as Antonelli nears title
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton apologised after overriding Ferrari's call and staying out on fading tyres, dropping from podium contention to sixth in Singapore. Kimi Antonelli's third place extends his championship lead to 102 points, meaning he could clinch his first F1 title at the US Grand Prix on 25 October.

stories.title: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire'; Zelensky backs it
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an immediate 'energy ceasefire'; Zelensky says Ukraine supports it, and Russia has yet to comment. Trump's announcement caught Ukraine by surprise, and French and EU leaders warned Moscow is still striking Ukrainian infrastructure.

stories.title: Houthis warn airlines off Saudi airports after deadly Riyadh strike
stories.summary: Yemen's Houthis warned airlines and passengers not to use Saudi airports and airspace after an attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport killed 12 and injured more than 300. The strike has shaken Saudi Arabia's standing as a regional safe haven, and the US has said it may join offensive strikes.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack this week
stories.summary: Ukraine hit a Yandex data centre near Moscow with a drone, forcing Russia's biggest tech firm to suspend operations there. It was the third Ukrainian attack on Yandex sites within a week, underscoring how the war increasingly targets civilian tech infrastructure.

stories.title: 139 migrants, 15 children, dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti
stories.summary: At least 139 migrants, including 15 children, died and 84 remain missing after an overcrowded boat carrying 305 people capsized while heading from Djibouti to Yemen, the UN migration agency said on Sunday. The vessel was mostly carrying Ethiopian migrants and is one of the deadliest shipwrecks on this route in years.

stories.title: Meta and Sierra launch Personal Agent Protocol for AI assistants
stories.summary: Meta and Sierra, with partners like Shopify, Stripe and Walmart, announced the Personal Agent Protocol — an open OAuth-based standard for how AI personal assistants authenticate and interact with businesses. OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon and Google are not yet signatories; a v0.1 spec is due later this month.

stories.title: Odyssey releases Odyssey-3 world model as free public preview
stories.summary: Odyssey released Odyssey-3, a 14-billion-parameter generative world model, as a free research preview. It builds real-time interactive environments from text prompts and can reportedly control robots, drones and even a running copy of GTA V, though its benchmark claims are unverified by outsiders.

stories.title: Researchers unveil 'context language models' that manage their own context
stories.summary: Researchers from Meta, MIT and UW introduced Context Language Models (CLMs), which let a model edit its own context instead of relying on fixed summarization or compression. They report higher accuracy with up to 59% fewer FLOPs on benchmarks like BrowseComp-Plus.

stories.title: KC Concepcion knocked out of Browns-Jets by Minkah Fitzpatrick hit
stories.summary: Browns rookie receiver KC Concepcion was knocked out of Sunday's game at the Jets after a hit that drew a personal foul on safety Minkah Fitzpatrick. The Browns trailed in a game where they were chasing their best start since 2020.

stories.title: Ohio State moves up to No. 4 in AP Top 25 after Maryland win
stories.summary: Ohio State rose to No. 4 in the AP Top 25 (with Georgia back at No. 1) after beating Maryland 45-16. The Buckeyes now face a brutal stretch, visiting No. 5 Indiana next weekend before USC and Oregon.

stories.title: Suspect in custody after fatal east Columbus shooting
stories.summary: Columbus police say the man who allegedly shot and killed one person and injured another in east Columbus on Sunday turned himself in. Officers took him into custody, closing the search for the suspect.
